$comment: Performance budgets checked by `pnpm perf:budget` (tools/perf-budget) in CI. A median over its ceiling fails the build. The first line is the product budget — a local-zoom update of 10,000 objects fits one 60 fps frame (docs/architecture/RENDERING.md); the rest are regression ceilings about three times what the build container measured on 2026-09-23 (in `measured`), so a CI runner's noise passes and a real slowdown does not. Raise a ceiling only with the reason in the commit.
